acceptanceCriteria: The shadow report refuses a window without the preregistered operator set, seed, catalog digest and compiler version.
Non-scoring verdicts are counted as misses in fixture tests.
Bounds and corrections match a reference computation.
Usefulness, minutes and cost appear per change and in aggregate.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. The current gate seeds test-side BBF controls, and an escape metric over merged changes is vacuous. Per amended CCE-V0-011/012: seeded regressions are preregistered application-side mutants (operators and seed frozen, applied identically to hosted and compiled sides), the window holds at least 10 bug-fix pairs and red-CI heads with an explicit denominator, every non-scoring verdict counts as a miss, the catalog digest and compiler version are frozen, and the report gives Clopper-Pearson bounds with Holm correction (a zero-miss upper bound under 5% needs n=59). Report per-change usefulness, time-to-verdict and cost.
